verdict.rationale: Inngest ships an official MCP server that lets users inspect and operate Inngest through natural-language coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, and its CLI is designed to give coding agents access to Inngest data. Natural-language operation therefore depends on a third-party MCP client rather than a built-in natural-language interface, and the depth of the supported operations is undocumented. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface in the product or dashboard, documentation of which operations can be performed via natural language, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Connect Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or another MCP client to inspect and operate Inngest from your coding agent.
give coding agents access to your Inngest data from the terminal.
